It enters tapped, but Authority of the Consuls does not trigger for it. The Nylea, God of the Hunt and Preyseizer Dragon enter the battlefield at the same time as the Nylea's Disciples leave the battlefield. Nylea, God of the Hunt was entering the battlefield as a creature immediately beforehand, so it enters tapped. (614.12) There are no choices involved for Player A (other than which creatures to devour), since the two replacement effects are applying to different objects. (616.1)

Once Nylea, God of the Hunt is on the battlefield it is not a creature, so Authority of the Consuls does not trigger. (611.3c)

tasks.question: Ari animates Restless Anchorage and equips Grafted Exoskeleton to it. What happens at the end of the turn?

tasks.question: Player A controls a Life and Limb, a Blood Moon, and a 1/1 Green Saproling Creature token, that entered the battlefield in that order. What is the Saproling?
tasks.answer: It's a 1/1 green Land Creature - Mountain Saproling with "{T}: Add {R}.". tasks.question: Player A controls Walk-In Closet // Forgotten Cellar. Can they cast Zoetic Cavern from their graveyard face down?
tasks.answer: No, they can't. Morph does function in the graveyard, since Zoetic Cavern could be played from there. tasks.question: Player A controls Whiptail Wurm which is enchanted by Witness Protection. Whiptail Wurm then becomes enchanted by One with the Stars. What happens?
tasks.answer:
Whiptail Wurm becomes an enchantment with no abilities and with the color dictated by Witness Protection. When state-based actions are checked, Witness Protection is attached to an illegal target and is put into the graveyard. Whiptail Wurm then regains all characteristics except its type is only enchantment. State-based actions are checked again. Nothing happens, and Player A gets priority.

This is an interaction of continuous effects, so the layers will need to be considered. (613.1) In this case, no changes occur until layer four. (613.1d) There are two effects occurring in this layer, so timestamps will need to be considered. (613.7) Since Witness Protection was attached first, Whiptail Wurm maintains its status as a creature. Then, One with the Stars turns Whiptail Wurm into an enchantment and removes all other types. Whiptail Wurm is changed to the color dictated by Witness Protection in layer five. (613.1e) Whiptail Wurm loses all abilities in layer six due to Witness Protection. (613.1f) Lastly, Whiptail Wurm has its power and toughness set to the values stated in Witness Protection in layer seven. (613.1g) When state-based actions are checked, Witness Protection is attached to an enchantment and is put into the graveyard. (704.5m) State-based actions are checked again, and nothing happens. (704.3)
